status: Working result with scoped independent local review. Formal review pending.

conventions.setup: Fixed mass intake, peak displacement b=1e-5, one draining arm, symmetric bend of the two well halves, normal motion f=sin²(pi w/H) times cos(theta).
conventions.carrier: Lab-frame integral of hbar Im(psi* grad psi) in phase with bdot, per unit peak bend speed. Reconstruct radial faces, integrate the linearized radial and angular dipole contributions over the prescribed volume. Use real 36R baths and the established outgoing continuations. Shape derivatives of an integration edge multiplying stationary momentum are in phase with b. Smallest shells depend on trace reconstruction.
conventions.wall: Conditional local nondispersive normal surface mass with identical inventories on both halves, detached from the accounted-for carrier and supporting wave. One-arm band Px/bdot=M_radial/6 integral_B h f du. Both-arm M_wall=M_radial/3 integral h f² du. With unequal halves sum separately. A general surface with tangential motion needs its normal conjugate projection.
conventions.construction: Reference pressure per depth from archived normalized cell masses, integrated with the exact f or f² inside each cell. Witness is 5% of that reference plus 95% of three normalized finite-width positive bumps. Fixed reference radial inertia, tension, intake, and readout. Same pair of band readings within 1e-11 in normalized moments.
conventions.bounds: For measured normalized e,c and one-arm radial normalization 1, let bE=1/2, a=sin²(3 pi/8), s=min(c/a,1-e/bE). Jensen gives min=e²/(1-s)+c²/s: place s in C, the remainder in E, with a constant f within each occupied band in the limiting distribution. For the supremum concentrate at bE in E, at 1 in C, and approach a in the unobserved shoulder. Then sup=bE e+c+a²(1-e/bE-c). Multiply by M_radial/3. Endpoints are understood as limiting measures if smooth positive densities are required.
conventions.spectrum: Assumed tension K=0.424660352295, measured frequency-dependent fluid and wave reactions, equal-area 1:3-width selective signals, common shift and no additional dephasing. The computed threshold applies within the tested inertia branch.

review.wall_verdict: Scoped clear for the one-arm normalization, the two-band mass bounds, and the conditional peak-count ambiguity.
review.carrier_verdict: Scoped clear for the laboratory-frame, velocity-in-phase GNLS carrier momentum integrated over the specified one-arm shells and bands at the two probe frequencies.
review.scope: Independent source audit and guarded numerical band integrals, optimization and spectral witnesses. The referee also checked the carrier momentum observable and normalization against the existing solver in source only. Both spectral reconstructions use the previously audited kernel.
review.limitations: Independent finite-volume integration of pressure cells and two LP mesh resolutions. Source check of moving-edge phase, angular factors and operator. The two innermost shell thickness comparisons are resolution-dependent. No wall material or unconstrained mouth inertia measured.
